\tablecomments{%
  Each rung adds one physics process to the previous configuration.
  All runs use $512^3$ resolution and identical initial
  conditions (50~Mpc comoving box, halo~569,
  $M_{200}\approx2\times10^{12}\,h^{-1}\,M_\odot$).
  Physics channel flags are in Table~\ref{tab:sim_grid}.
  $M_\star/M_{\rm halo}$: stellar-to-halo mass ratio within $R_{200}$.
  $M_{\rm dust}/M_\star$: dust-to-stellar mass ratio within $R_{200}$.
  $f_{\rm surv}$: surviving dust fraction
  $N_{\rm alive}/(N_{\rm alive}+N_{\rm destroyed,cumul})$.
  $\langle a\rangle_{\rm ISM}$: mass-weighted mean grain radius
  for dust in the ISM aperture ($r<20\,{\rm pkpc}$,
  $n_H>0.1\,{\rm cm}^{-3}$).
  $\langle a\rangle_{200}$: same, for all dust within $R_{200}$.
  $D/G|_{\rm ISM}$, $D/Z|_{\rm ISM}$: dust-to-gas and dust-to-metals
  ratios restricted to the ISM aperture above.
  $D/G$, $D/Z$: same ratios using total gas and metals within $R_{200}$.
  $\bar{f}_{\rm C}$: mass-weighted mean carbon fraction within $R_{200}$.
  MW references: $M_\star/M_{\rm halo}$ from \citet{blandhawthorn16};
  $D/G$ and $M_{\rm dust}/M_\star$ from \citet{draine07};
  $D/Z$ from \citet{jenkins09} (ISM sightlines, so ISM = global).
}
